sections.title: Mission and Purpose
points: Internal audit’s mission is to enhance and protect organizational value by providing risk-based and objective assurance, advice, and insight.
The internal audit’s purpose is to provide independent, objective assurance and consulting services designed to add value and improve the organization’s operations.
